crossRefs.note: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but…
They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you…
Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore…
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
Generation, consider Yahweh’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people…
“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called…

translations.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
translations.bsb: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
translations.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
